utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Ira — are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I’m still in — I’ll swing by after I finish my errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand—what tools do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — tools. I think we’ll need a hammer, a wrench, and maybe some screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring a hammer, a wrench, and a set of screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s getting a nice turnout, and people are bringing in all sorts of things to fix up. I’ll let you know if I hear anything more specific!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear—I just worry about the drop-off details and whether they’ve got enough space. If you hear the time or location, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll keep an ear out and pass along the time and location as soon as I hear them. Hopefully they’ve got plenty of room for everyone’s stuff!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you check the donation box by the community center and then drop off any tools at my garage on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll check the donation box at the community center and drop any tools off at your garage on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in — I’ll spread the word and see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I really appreciate you helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad you brought it up, Leo — let’s keep the repair drive moving. What’s the first thing you want to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the broken front-step railing. I can grab measurements and call the hardware store.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll note down the railing as first priority and keep the list organized. Send me the measurements, and I’ll help track the hardware store quote.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which repair items are included, just so I get the details right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’d need to check the list again, since I’m not fully sure of the exact items offhand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No problem — please check the list when you can, and let me know the exact items. I want to make sure I’ve got it right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I need to work around the school pickup times, but I can help coordinate the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — if you can coordinate, that’d be a huge help. Could you confirm a couple of volunteers and let me know which pickup windows we should avoid?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll confirm a couple of volunteers and avoid the usual pickup windows. I should have a list for you shortly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting organized — is there anything I should bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Nell — if you can bring a few tools or some extra gloves, that would help a lot. We’re still sorting out the list, but I’ll let you know as soon as we know what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll keep an eye out for tools and gloves, and let me know if you hear of anything else needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—have we actually confirmed the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Not yet—I just wanted to check if we’ve got the date and place locked in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a little foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I’ll let you know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll repeat the repair drive plan to everyone and make sure the details get around.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word and keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting some good momentum—people around the neighborhood have been chipping in. If you need, I can keep an eye out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to ask if you still needed any help with it. I can swing by and lend a hand if you want.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that’d be great — I could use an extra pair of hands. I’ll let you know what time to come by.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, just text me when you’ve got a time. I’ll keep an eye out and be there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’ve been a bit out of it, but what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a few tools and any spare screws you’ve got. If you can drop them off later, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can do that. I’ll look for some tools and spare screws and drop them off later.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand or a tool if you need one for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll stop by tomorrow morning with a clear list so we can keep it simple and get it done.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll be ready with a few tools and a helping hand. See you tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in—what needs fixing, and when should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing—thank you! We’re tackling the loose porch rail, that leaky gutter, and a couple of squeaky hinges on Saturday morning around 9.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll be there Saturday at 9 and can help with the porch rail and hinges. If you’ve got tools handy, I’ll bring gloves and a can-do attitude.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it’s a great way to help folks out and bring everyone together. Want me to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — that would be a huge help. I’m keeping track of the drop-off spots, so once I have the details, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send me the drop-off spots when you have them, and I’ll start sharing the word around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’ve got the repair drive details lined up, and I’m happy to help coordinate anything you need. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — let’s start by checking what supplies we already have and what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll make a quick inventory of what we’ve got and flag the gaps. Then we can make a clean list of anything to borrow or buy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive. If you tell me what’s needed, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — we need volunteers, tools, and a few donations for the repairs. Can you help by telling folks to sign up and bring what they can?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll pass it along and tell folks to sign up and bring whatever they can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sounds good — I’m in. Just send me the basics and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll send you the details and the school pickup times so we can coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — just send me the basics and the pickup times, and I’ll work around them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re actually in for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m in for the repair drive.
